$meta.name: SkinKey
$meta.direction: Clay & Ink, with four grafts from Deep Teal
grafts: Provenance 'Where this comes from' ledger set like a dispensing label: small-caps keys SKIN / PRODUCT / LIMITS, a 1dp ink rule on top and hairline rows (component.provenanceLedger)
Verdict tint confined to the verdict HEAD; reasons sit on the plain screen surface (component.verdictCard.body has no tint)
Band meters drawn in neutral ink, never the accent (semantic meter.*)
Pharmacist-at-counter icon (with one bottle on the counter) for the medicine gate; the mortar and pestle is retired (icon.verdict.medicine)
$meta.units: All sizes are dp (React Native density-independent px). CSS output converts 1dp = 1px. letterSpacing is in dp, as React Native expects; CSS output also gives em.

aliasSyntax.{color.text}: semantic colour in the active mode (semantic.color.<mode>.<path>)

tuningHistory: Started from clay-ink.tokens.json values (86 pairs, all passing) and applied the judge fixes before gating.

text-muted light #655B4D -> #564D41 (sand.700) so a real third level fits: text-subtle #6B6152 still reaches 4.77:1 on bg-sunken. Dark text-subtle sand.450 #9E9282 reaches 5.01:1 on surface-raised (and 4.68:1 as disabled-fg on the sand.850 disabled fill).
border-strong unified to sand.500 #807464 in both modes (lowest: 3.35:1 on dark surface-raised; 3.58:1 on light bg-sunken).

Dark accent #B0C5C7 (read as disabled) -> ink.300 #86A4A7 with ink.950 #0C171A text, 6.84:1. Dark accent-pressed ink.400 redefined #5E8286 -> #6B8C90 so the label still reaches 5.01:1. Dark focus ring moved to ink.200 so it stays visible around the deepened button.

Verdict borders raised from decorative hairlines (#3F5534 / #5E4920 in dark, about 1.4:1) to the 500 step of each hue, gated at 3:1 against bg and surface in both modes. Fixes the dark CAUTION edge that disappeared.
Verdict icons get their own 600 (light) / 400 (dark) step: CAUTION icon #8A5D12 is 4.65:1 on its tint, above the Deep Teal fix target #95620F (4.22:1 here).
Meter filled moved from chip-fg to sand.800 / sand.150 (neutral ink); empty stays a full-opacity border-strong outline.

Checker first run: 228 pairs, 0 contrast failures, 2 lint failures (both rule false-positives: HSL saturation overstated near-white sand; the mortar-and-pestle test matched the 'no mortar' note). Rules corrected; negative test with six planted defects caught all six.

v1.1 (critique round 2). Verdict head: inset 3dp stripe deleted (no rule token); sentence set in Newsreader type.verdictLine 20/26; 1dp tinted border; radius.lg 12. FITS and CAUTION heads have near-equal luminance, so the 24dp silhouette and the caps label carry the difference in greyscale (documented, not hidden).

v1.1. UNKNOWN head moved off cool slate onto warm paper (sand.150 light / sand.850 dark) with a dashed border, so it no longer reads as the ink 'info, tap me' family. Dark FITS and CAUTION fills desaturated about 30% (moss.900 #1E2A1A -> #1F281C, ochre.900 #2D2313 -> #292217).

v1.1. Dark accent-subtle ink.900 -> ink.700 #253D41 so the selected nav pill reads (1.33:1 on the bar, matching light); ink.100 on it is 8.55:1. Nav selection is carried by weight (600 vs 400) and a 2.25 stroke, not colour alone.
v1.1. New focus-ring-inverse (ink.200 light / ink.700 dark) for the snackbar, and focus-ring-overlay (white + 1dp rgba(0,0,0,0.6) halo) for camera controls; both gated.
v1.1. Medicine head is no longer a box: verdict.medicine.bg = the screen bg and component borderWidth 0. The pharmacist icon gains one bottle on the counter.
v1.1. Shadow colour is a primitive (sand.shadow #423B32) aliased through color.shadow; dark is transparent.
v1.1. Reason line 18/26 400 -> 19/26 500 with a 6dp fact gap; display and title use a bundled Newsreader 36pt optical-size instance in RN (opsz axis on the web).
v1.1. Every fixed height on a text-bearing part is now minHeight (appBar, bottomNav, tag/hint use visualMinHeight because they are not targets). A lint fails any 'height' key next to a type token.
$meta.sourceOfTruth: This file. theme.ts and tokens.css are generated by build-tokens.mjs; check-contrast.mjs gates every pair. Do not hand-edit the outputs.

sand.$description: Warm paper neutrals. Half steps (25, 150, 450, 850, 925, 975) exist because the light and dark surface stacks need finer tone steps than a plain 11-step ramp gives. 'shadow' is the clay shadow tint used by light-mode elevation only.

ink.$description: The single accent: deep blue-green printing ink. Used for buttons, links, focus and selection only. Never a verdict, never a meter.

moss.$description: FITS. Muted moss green, kept well away from the ink accent's hue.

ochre.$description: CAUTION. Ochre or turmeric, hue 35 to 45 degrees. Never red, never an alarm.

slate.$description: UNKNOWN icon, label and dashed edge only. The UNKNOWN head fill is warm sand, so slate never reads as the ink accent family.

$notes.border: Decorative hairline (dividers, card edges). Never the only edge of a control; not gated under WCAG 1.4.11.
$notes.border-strong: Edges that carry meaning: outlined buttons, inputs, empty meter segments, sheet handle. Gated at 3:1 on every surface.
$notes.text-subtle: Third text level (timestamps, helper text). Still gated at 4.5:1 on every surface it can sit on, so it is never 'too faint to read'.
$notes.accent: Light: near-black ink #1B2F32. Dark: deepened to ink.300 #86A4A7 with ink.950 #0C171A text (6.84:1), replacing the washed-out #B0C5C7 that judges read as disabled.
$notes.accent-pressed: Moves toward the background, like a Material 3 state layer: lighter ink in light mode, darker ink in dark mode. Still >=4.5:1 with on-accent.
$notes.focus-ring: 2dp outline, 2dp offset, drawn over bg (so gated against surfaces, not the button fill). Dark uses ink.200 so the ring stays visible around the ink.300 button.
$notes.verdict: bg/fg/border/icon apply to the verdict HEAD only. Reasons always sit on the plain screen surface. Border is a 1dp tinted edge, gated at 3:1. No leading stripe: in greyscale FITS and CAUTION heads are near-equal in tone, so the icon silhouette and the caps label carry the state.
$notes.verdict.medicine: Not a box: the fill equals the screen bg and the component draws no border. Pharmacist icon at 32dp, one serif line, no verdict label. Not an alarm.
$notes.meter: Neutral ink only, never accent. Empty segments are a full-opacity 1dp border-strong outline (>=3:1).
$notes.overlay-camera: Dims the live camera around the capture oval and barcode window. Gated for on-overlay text over a worst-case white frame.
$notes.qr: QR is always black modules on a white field in both modes, for scanner reliability.
$notes.error: SkinKey has no red. Errors are neutral: icon + text + 2dp text-colour field border. CAUTION is never an error colour.
$notes.focus-ring-inverse: Focus ring on inverse surfaces (snackbar action). ink.200 on sand.850 light, ink.700 on sand.150 dark.
$notes.focus-ring-overlay: Focus ring over the live camera or a photo: 2dp white outline with a 1dp overlay-halo inner ring, gated over a worst-case white and black frame.
$notes.overlay-halo: 1dp dark halo either side of white strokes over photos (try-on divider, overlay focus ring).
$notes.verdict.unknown: Warm paper fill (sand.150 / sand.850) with a dashed slate edge and the dashed-circle icon. Not cool slate, so it never reads as 'info, tap me'.
$notes.accent-subtle: Selected nav pill, selected segmented button. Dark is ink.700 so the pill is visible on the bar.

serif.name: Newsreader
serif.role: Reading content: display, titles, section heads, verdict line, reasons, product names, countdown
serif.opticalSizing: Web: load the opsz axis (6..72) and keep font-optical-sizing: auto. RN: display and title use the bundled 36pt static instance (serif-display); everything else uses the 16pt instances from @expo-google-fonts/newsreader.

sans.name: Commissioner
sans.role: Controls, labels, verdict label, body, fine print

$local.Newsreader36pt_500Medium: assets/fonts/Newsreader36pt_500Medium.ttf (static instance of Newsreader[opsz,wght] at opsz 36, wght 500; OFL)

display.use: Landing hero, onboarding headline, home 'Check a product'

title.use: Product title on /check, screen titles, the medicine-gate line, consent lead clause

headline.use: Card heads, 'Where this comes from', sheet titles, empty-state sentence, forecast sentence

verdictLine.use: The verdict sentence under the label ('May not suit your readings. This is not a safety warning.'), one unit in one style

section.use: Sentence-case section heads that replaced tracked-caps eyebrows: 'Why · 2 reasons', 'Readings by zone', 'What we keep'

reason.use: Reason reading line. Out-sizes the 15dp verdict label (P1); weight 500 so it leads the 16dp fact.

verdictLabel.use: FITS / CAUTION / UNKNOWN, with a 24dp icon. Never truncates; wraps at max font scale.

body.use: Body copy, the product fact in each reason (full text colour), consent body

bodyStrong.use: Band value (High), emphasised step, list row title

bodySm.use: Ledger values, supporting lines, card secondary text

label.use: Chip and band names, field labels, snackbar action

labelSmRegular.use: Unselected bottom-nav label (selection is weight + stroke + pill, never colour alone)

overline.use: Ledger keys SKIN / PRODUCT / WEATHER / LIMITS only. The verdict label is the only other caps line. No section eyebrows.

caption.use: Destination lines, disclosures, meter labels (Low / Med / High), timestamps

fine.use: Data credits only (Open-Meteo CC BY 4.0, Open Beauty Facts ODbL). The floor: nothing in SkinKey is smaller than 12.

rules.numerals: Dates, prices, SPF, countdowns and reason indices use tabular figures (RN fontVariant ['tabular-nums'], CSS font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).
rules.android: includeFontPadding: false; textAlignVertical: 'center' on single-line labels. Do not set fontWeight on custom families in React Native: the weight is baked into the family key (Newsreader_500Medium). Check Commissioner tracking on a real Android device.
rules.fontScaling: allowFontScaling stays on and maxFontSizeMultiplier is 2.0 on every style (theme.ts textProps). Layouts reflow at 2.0x: buttons stack at 1.3x, ledger keys stack and the sticky action bar becomes inline at 1.5x, nav labels wrap to 2 lines. Verdict labels and reasons never truncate (no numberOfLines).
rules.serifUse: Serif for reading content; sans for controls and fine print. Never serif below 18dp.
rules.web: tokens.css sets font sizes in rem (16px root) and unitless line heights, so the browser text-size setting scales type without clipping. Spacing stays px.

$usage.lg: cards, verdict head, ledger, QR card

elevation.$approach: Tone first. Light mode: paper stack (bg-sunken < bg < surface < surface-raised) plus one soft clay-tinted shadow, never pure black. Dark mode: tone steps and hairlines only, no shadows.

1.use: Cards on bg: profile card, product match, forecast, share teaching

2.use: Sticky action bar once content scrolls under it, bottom nav (shadow casts upward)

3.use: Sheets and snackbars get a border-strong edge instead of a shadow

motion.$personality: Ink settling: unhurried, decelerating, no springs, no overshoot, nothing loops.

linear.use: QR countdown rule and determinate progress only

enter.$use: Reason stagger translateY and verdict reveal / press scale start values

timing.$rule: Android: pass durations through AccessibilityInfo.getRecommendedTimeoutMillis. While TalkBack is on, a snackbar with an action stays until dismissed.

patterns.press: bg to state.pressed (or accent-pressed) in {duration.press}; optional scale 0.98 as a transform only, so layout never shifts. Android: ripple in state.ripple.
patterns.verdictReveal: opacity 0 to 1 and scale 0.98 to 1 over {duration.verdictReveal}, ease decelerate. One light haptic tick when the verdict lands; no extra haptic on CAUTION.
patterns.reasons: opacity 0 to 1 and translateY 6dp to 0, {duration.reasonStagger} stagger, max 3 items
patterns.processingStep: Each tick draws once in {duration.stepTick}. The current step is a static filled ring; no spinner loop.
patterns.sheet: translateY from 100% with {ease.decelerate}, scrim fades in over {duration.state}

reducedMotion.rule: Every transition becomes an opacity crossfade of {duration.crossfade}. No translate, no scale, no stagger. Step ticks appear without drawing. Countdown digits change without animating. (Grain is a static tile, so reduce motion does not change it.)

touch.$rule: Every tappable element is a Pressable whose own box is at least 48 x 48dp, reached with minHeight/minWidth plus padding. hitSlop only where the parent already has 48dp of room (Android never delivers touches outside the parent). Never a nested <Text onPress> for an action: inline links become standalone rows in RN.

icon.library: lucide-react-native (web: lucide) at 1.75 stroke; custom SVGs drawn on the same 24dp grid and stroke

fits.meaning: Scalloped seal with a check. The only non-circular verdict silhouette.

caution.meaning: Partly fits. Never a triangle, never an exclamation mark.

unknown.meaning: Incomplete information. Not an error glyph.

medicine.lucide: custom: head and shoulders behind a counter, one small bottle standing on the counter, 1.75 stroke; reads at 20dp
medicine.meaning: Ask the pharmacist. No cross, no plus, no pill, no mortar and pestle, no alert.

avoid: share/upload glyph for provenance ('Shared from' uses arrow-down-left)

grain.tile: assets/texture/grain-160.png (static 160 x 160 greyscale PNG, not an SVG filter, never animated)
forbidden: behind body text, reasons, ledger rows or forms
card and sheet surfaces themselves (the illustration panel inside the share-teaching card is the one exception)

zIndex.$rn: On Android, elevation also orders siblings; set elevation alongside zIndex for sheets and snackbars.

focus.$rule: One focus recipe for every control. Measured against the surface around the control, not its fill.

destructiveNeutral.$rule: Delete, Revoke. No red: a strong ink outline plus a verb label and an icon, always followed by a confirmation step.

consentPair.$rule: Start scan / Not now on every consent screen: identical fill, edge, size and type, so declining is never the weaker-looking choice.

actionBar.$rule: Sticky bar on /check. One primary, then one 48dp tertiary. Only the link-out carries a destination line. Border-top and elevation.2 appear only while content scrolls under the bar. Render it after the ScrollView in JSX so TalkBack reaches it last. At font scale >= 1.5 the actions move inline to the end of the content.

textLink.$rule: Standalone links are Pressables with a 48dp box. Inline links inside a sentence exist on the web only; in RN the action moves to its own row.

productHeader.$rule: Title, kicker and meta are one header node; the Edit link is a sibling rendered after it (positioned top-right).
productHeader.title: {type.title}

medicineGate.$rule: No box, no label, no reasons, no ledger, no matches. The 32dp pharmacist icon sits above one serif line, about a third of the way down the content area. One action: Back to product.

nameOnly.$rule: FITS or CAUTION head colours with a dashed border and the qualifier 'based on product name only' inside the label node.

body.$rule: Reasons sit on the plain screen surface. The verdict tint never extends past the head, and CAUTION never fills the screen.

bandChip.$rule: Compact chip inside a reason row: text first, the meter only repeats it. Non-interactive by default; the interactive variant is a Pressable with a 48dp box around the 32dp visual.

bandList.$rule: /profile bands, set like the dispensing-label ledger: heavier top and bottom ink rules, hairline rows, one Low / Medium / High legend above the list. Name on the left in sans, band word on the right in serif with the neutral meter under it.
bandList.name: {type.body}

tag.$rule: Static tags are not tappable and are read inline with their parent. Anything tappable is a band chip (interactive) or a text link.

skinMap.$rule: Photo-free zone diagram traced from YouCam masks. No photo, no skin colour. Band = hatch density (none Low, single 45 degree hatch Medium, cross-hatch High), never fill lightness. Every zone also has a text row in the adjacent list. Mirrored like a selfie, so cheeks are labelled 'Your left' / 'Your right'.
skinMap.heading: {type.section}
skinMap.label: {type.caption}

provenanceLedger.$rule: Set like a dispensing label: 1.5dp ink rules top and bottom, small-caps keys, hairline rows, no tinted box. Below 380dp width (or at font scale >= 1.5) the key sits above the value. Group only the text of a row; a link in the row is a sibling node after it.
provenanceLedger.title: {type.headline}
provenanceLedger.caption: {type.caption}

bottomSheet.$rule: Render every sheet inside RN Modal (or set importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants' on the screen root while open). On open, AccessibilityInfo.setAccessibilityFocus(titleRef); on close, return focus to the trigger's ref. A Close button or Cancel action always exists; the handle is never the only way out.
bottomSheet.title: {type.headline}

consentSheet.$rule: The approved privacy sentence stays one sentence and one TalkBack block; its first clause is set larger so the promise lands first.
consentSheet.$actions: button.consentPair (Start scan, Not now), side by side; stacked at font scale >= 1.3

captureGuide.$rule: Static guide, no face detection. One instruction line above the oval, one hint at a time below it. Volume keys fire the shutter on a single press (both together is the TalkBack shortcut).
captureGuide.$spokenHint: Hold the phone at eye level, about an arm's length away.

processingStepper.$rule: Neutral ink only, never the accent. Numerals sit inside pending and active rings so the active glyph can't be mistaken for the UNKNOWN dashed circle. One hidden polite live region per screen announces step changes; the list itself is not a live region.

deletedStep.label: {type.bodyStrong}
deletedStep.caption: {type.caption}
deletedStep.$rule: 'Photo deleted from YouCam' is its own visible step with a tick and a timestamp.

storeLinkOut.label: {type.button}
storeLinkOut.$rule: The button that leaves SkinKey for a store search carries one destination line under it: 'Opens a Flipkart search, filtered to Oily Skin'. 'Back to product' explains itself and carries none. Text-only store names, no logos.

copy: Ranked by fit to your skin. No paid placements.
We may earn a commission; it never changes the ranking.

forecastCard.$rule: Group only the text (kicker, sentence, body, credit). 'Check a sunscreen' is a sibling node after the group.

tryOnCompare.$rule: 'Preview, not a shade guarantee' is attached to the bottom edge of the frame on the plain surface, never over the photo, and always visible. Hatch is never used here; hatch means skin-map band only.

qrShareCard.title: {type.headline}
qrShareCard.$announce: Hidden live region only, at 25, 20, 15, 10, 5 and 1 min (motion.timing.qrAnnounceEverySec / qrFinalAnnounceSec). The visible countdown is never a live region.

stateView.$rule: Empty, error and offline states. Left-aligned, no icon disc, one serif sentence with a real detail, one tertiary action. Neutral, never red. Offline actions are disabled, not hidden.
stateView.title: {type.headline}

offlineBanner.$rule: A list-row style line with a hairline under it, not a tinted slab. Polite live region when it appears.

bottomNav.$rule: Top-level screens only (home, /profile). Hidden on pushed details: /check, better matches, try-on, QR share. Selection = pill + weight 600 + 2.25 stroke + colour; never colour alone. role tablist on the container; each item role tab, label 'Check', accessibilityState.selected, position in the hint.
